name: Big Bucks Saloon

features.name: Revolver feature
features.description: Fires three shots to create wilds or add multipliers, moving down each spin.

features.name: Sticky free spins
features.description: 12 free spins where all wilds stick.

review:
A 20-line western where the revolver steals the show. Whenever it lands it fires three shots at the reels – hit symbols turn wild, or wilds already there pick up multipliers. Then it drops a row, reloads and fires again until it falls off the reels.

Three scatters on reels 2 to 4 give 12 free spins where every wild sticks for the rest of the round, so those revolver wilds really pile up. High volatility, 10,000x max and a strong 97.01% RTP. Free spins roughly once every 305 spins.
pros: Excellent 97.01% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus is rare (about 1 in 305 spins on average)
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
